verdict: Ads are delivering leads steadily; the pipeline is not receiving them.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign brought in 159 leads at a cost of $12.66 per lead, and the most recent 7-day trend shows leads up 9% with cost per lead essentially flat — the ad side is healthy. The problem is downstream: your CRM shows zero opportunities created from those leads, meaning no lead has entered your pipeline this period. That is a CRM intake issue, not an ads issue, and it is the immediate priority. Separately, your Google Business Profile went dark over the last four days of the period — actions that were averaging 8 per day dropped to zero — and we are investigating the cause. SMS automation and voice access, both needed to improve contact rates with incoming leads, are also being brought online now.

highlights.phrase: leads received from paid ads in the last 28 days
cost per lead this period, stable week over week
leads entered into your pipeline — CRM intake is being repaired now

watch_item.issue: Your CRM shows zero pipeline opportunities from 159 incoming leads — leads are arriving but not being captured for follow-up.
watch_item.fix: CRM intake is being corrected this week, alongside activating SMS automation and voice access to ensure leads can be reached immediately once the pipeline is live.
